forum.title: Error downloading the following files: api_config.json (Not Available)
forum.best_answer_content: I think this problem is caused by new update. I've been working in Cube for several years but I've never updated the software. After replacing CubeMX with newer it works fine.
forum.content_text: This error pops up everytime I try creating a new STM32 project when downloading the selected files during the first stages of creating a project. My internet connection is fine and this wasn't an issue some weeks back with the last project I created. Any assistance on this issue from anyone will be very helpful because I'm a quite a newbie to CubeIDE. Thanks.
forum.author: Marvin_k

scraped_replies.html: I think this problem is caused by new update. I've been working in Cube for several years but I've never updated the software. After replacing CubeMX with newer it works fine.
scraped_replies.author: Adison112

scraped_replies.html: I was still able to build my project and flash the MCU after clicking the box away, so it didn't end up really interfering this time. I feel that I'll eventually run into some project that'll need those missing files though. Anyway, I also haven't updated my CubeIDE so that might be it.
scraped_replies.author: Marvin_k

scraped_replies.html: Same problem, happens also with creating new project from existing .ioc file. After the download fails project creation menu appears but IDE gets stuck in Progress Information tab and nothing is clickable. I'm using CubeIDE v1.19.
scraped_replies.author: AA6

scraped_replies.html: Quick update: When I did not click OK to api_config.json error it disappeared on its own and I was able to create a project. Then I downloaded firmware packages I needed from MX UI (manage software packages)
scraped_replies.author: AA6
